releaseNotes: Added an always-on Design Evidence Stack that routes motion, trust, conversion, delight, flow, and component questions to six bounded design sources.
Required source triage and adopted evidence in the Design Room contract. Added validator coverage and a LaunchBench case for copied patterns and unsupported experiment claims.
Added General Legal's CC0 template collection as an optional privacy and terms drafting benchmark, with official-source and counsel-review boundaries.

Hardened Design Evidence validation for rendered sections and scoped rows, strict nested Markdown fences, comments, raw script/style/template blocks, and indented code, resumable session-scoped serialized dependency refresh with applicability-first admission, abandoned-scope cleanup, scoped and unscoped dispatch authorization, dependency and consumer attempt budgets, later-session failure retries, unaccepted failed bytes, sibling-result preservation, transient instructions, preserved change baselines, stale-token invalidation, and zero-output boundary results, lane-bound fallback sources, comprehensive standard-component routing, unique declarations and triage, ambiguous product terminology, and contiguous rendered motion tables.
